The [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]] '''Mimic Decoy System''' was a drone that was controlled by a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] brain to project electromagnetic signals and [[holograph]]ic images in order to appear to be an actual full-sized [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. The drone would then fly upon preset flight paths or be remotely controlled by the host ship via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. Each Mimic came with five pre-loaded "false image options", allowing the decoy to appear to be the host ship, a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]], [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class Shuttle]], [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300]], or even a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian corvette]]. Owners could also program the decoy to appear to be another ship.
